name: first-setup-demo
capture: Actual Android app on a clean emulator, first setup after installation. PINs are demo digits typed on the app's keypad.
demonstrated_actions: Set primary, duress and decoy PINs
Enable and select Quantum Keyboard in Android settings
Identity key generation at first boot
limits: Recorded on an emulator, not a phone
Duress and decoy PINs shown as configuration only; no wipe or decoy triggered
Debug build of the Pro edition
editing: Waiting removed; PIN typing accelerated 5-6x, calculator typing 1.5x. Two takes of the same setup joined: the keyboard and boot part was recorded again after a fresh install. Android status bar replaced with chapter labels.

scenes.label: 01 / INITIALIZE / ACCELERATED
scenes.en: Initialize: the app prepares this phone as a secure endpoint.
scenes.it: Inizializza: l’app prepara il telefono come nodo sicuro.

scenes.label: 02 / INPUT MODE
scenes.en: Choose the input: Quantum Keyboard or the system keyboard.
scenes.it: Scegli l’input: Quantum Keyboard o la tastiera di sistema.

scenes.label: 03 / PRIMARY PIN / DEMO DIGITS
scenes.en: Set the primary PIN that opens the app.
scenes.it: Imposta il PIN principale che apre l’app.

scenes.label: 04 / DURESS AND DECOY / CONFIGURATION ONLY
scenes.en: Add a duress PIN that wipes data and a decoy PIN that opens a fake vault. Configuration only.
scenes.it: Aggiungi un PIN di emergenza che cancella i dati e un PIN esca che apre un vault finto. Solo configurazione.

scenes.label: 05 / QUANTUM KEYBOARD
scenes.en: Quantum Keyboard is enabled in Android settings.
scenes.it: Quantum Keyboard si attiva nelle impostazioni di Android.

scenes.label: 05 / ANDROID WARNING
scenes.en: Android shows its standard warning for every third-party keyboard.
scenes.it: Android mostra il suo avviso standard per ogni tastiera di terze parti.

scenes.label: 05 / SELECT KEYBOARD / ANDROID
scenes.en: Back in the app, pick Quantum Keyboard in the system picker.
scenes.it: Tornato nell’app, scegli Quantum Keyboard nel selettore di sistema.

scenes.label: 06 / IDENTITY KEYS / FIRST BOOT
scenes.en: Meanwhile the app saves the PINs and creates the identity key pair (RSA-2048) in the Android Keystore.
scenes.it: Intanto l’app salva i PIN e crea la coppia di chiavi dell’identità (RSA-2048) nel Keystore di Android.

scenes.label: 07 / CALCULATOR COVER
scenes.en: The app opens behind a working calculator. Type the PIN and = to enter.
scenes.it: L’app si apre dietro una calcolatrice funzionante. Digita il PIN e = per entrare.

scenes.label: 08 / NOTIFICATIONS / ANDROID
scenes.en: Allow notifications for messages and calls.
scenes.it: Consenti le notifiche per messaggi e chiamate.

scenes.label: 08 / BACKGROUND / ANDROID
scenes.en: Allow background activity so messages and calls reach you.
scenes.it: Consenti l’attività in background per ricevere messaggi e chiamate.

scenes.label: 09 / HOME / TOR ONLINE
scenes.en: Home: Tor online, ready for the first contact.
scenes.it: Home: Tor online, pronta per il primo contatto.
